description: Synthesize a short MP3 preview for a house voice, optionally speaking your own text (returns base64 audio; 10 previews per day).

text.description: Optional words for the house voice to speak (1-300 chars, English). Omit to hear the fixed sample. Previews are free and limited to 10 per user per day.

voiceId.description: House voice id from list_voices (e.g. chatterbox:phonon_zoey)

name: preview_house_voice
